program:
root = Col([heading, totalInput, result], 4, "stretch")
$total = 100
heading = Title("三人预算分摊", "lg")
totalInput = Input($total, "预算总额", "number", "输入总额")
shares = @Allocate(@Default($total, 0), [1, 1, 1], 2)
result = Card([Text("每人分摊", "sm", "muted"), Title(@Join(shares, " / "), "lg"), Caption("按两位小数分摊；余数按顺序分配，合计等于总额四舍五入至两位小数后的结果。")])
